Karl Knox Smithson

Independent candidate for Governor, Tennessee · Open seat

Homeless community activist (according to Politics1 and WSMV)

Karl Knox Smithson is an independent candidate for Tennessee governor from McMinnville, Warren County. He got onto the November 3, 2026 general election ballot by petition: he filed on February 19, 2026, and the Secretary of State approved his signatures. He has no previous political experience.

Background

  • Resides in McMinnville, Warren County, Tennessee
  • Occupation: homeless community activist (according to Politics1 and WSMV)
  • No prior elected office or political background (WSMV)
  • Filed petition for governor on February 19, 2026; signatures approved by the Tennessee Secretary of State
